project_type: Static HTML/CSS/JS website - sibling apology simulator
build_system: None - pure static files, GitHub Pages deployment
test_framework: None - manual browser testing, structural validation via grep/checks
verification_instructions: 1. Verify index.html, style.css, script.js exist. 2. Run node --check script.js for syntax. 3. Grep for no eval(), no inline handlers. 4. Verify CSP meta tag. 5. Verify Inter font loading. 6. Verify state machine pattern with enter/render/exit. 7. Verify T key test mode. 8. Verify smart media detection logic.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. Clone repo and open index.html in a browser.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external packages installable. Cannot load external fonts at runtime in sandbox testing (but app will load them on GitHub Pages). Use node --check for JS syntax validation only.
contribution_requirements: Deploy to GitHub Pages. No Node.js, React, Next.js, or backend. Must work by opening index.html directly. Use Inter font from Google Fonts CDN (will work on GitHub Pages). Security: no eval(), no inline JS, textContent over innerHTML, addEventListener only.
key_patterns: Single page application with screen transitions. State machine architecture with centralized state. Each screen state has enter(), render(), exit() methods. Premium dark luxury glassmorphism UI. Mobile-first responsive.
directory_structure: Root contains index.html, style.css, script.js, README.md. images/ folder for optional meme and memory gallery photos.
